feature: Module 025 — admin UI for SOW canonical-reference (content) templates (Stage 4)

killSwitch.note: The canonical-reference endpoints 404 and neither the Canonical references library entry nor the author selection control renders unless this is set to true. Run the flag-ON flows against an environment where it is true.

preconditions: PROJECTPULSE_MODULE025_REFERENCE_SOURCES_ENABLED=true in the app environment for the flag-ON flows.
Signed in as an Administrator (not in View-As) to exercise create/edit/replace/delete.
A separate Solution Architect account with generation authority to confirm author selection is read-only for non-admins.
A clean SOW template .docx (no customer data) available to upload.

flows.name: flag OFF — no library entry and endpoints 404

steps.note: Sign in and open Module 025 SOW & GSD Workspace with the flag OFF.
No Canonical references sub-tab; the immutable Template candidates view is unchanged.
No author selection control renders in the Service Scope / generate step.

flows.name: flag ON — admin creates a canonical reference

steps.note: Set the Label (and optionally Project name).

flows.name: flag ON — admin edits label and reference text

fill.value: Edited canonical reference text used to steer the generated SOW citation.

flows.name: flag ON — deactivating removes it from author selection

steps.note: A deactivated reference is NOT author-selectable; only active references appear.

flows.name: flag ON — author selection sends the identifier only

steps.openEngagement: an editable engagement with a meaningful Service Scope

expectRequest.note: Only the identifier is sent; reference text never leaves the server.

flows.name: flag ON — non-admin (SA) sees active references read-only

steps.note: Sign in as a Solution Architect with generation authority (not an administrator).

flows.name: flag ON — administrator View-As is read-only

steps.note: Sign in as an administrator, then enter View-As for another user.
